ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Widens the AC coverage ratchet (gate) step's trigger from pull_request-only to also push-to-main (feeder a only; no merge base needed), and adds a push-only --check-baseline-growth --parent-sha <before-sha> flag diffing the baseline file's own committed bytes against the push's pre-image via the repo's hardened git_blob_read helpers (Stage-3 doubt review: a raw git show risked an uncaught UnicodeDecodeError turning an infra fault into a red main). Uses the push's before SHA (not bare HEAD~1) for multi-commit pushes; the before SHA is double-quoted in the run line for consistency with sibling gates. This surfaces a same-PR self-grandfathered entry as a red push run but does not durably close it (detective, self-clearing next push, disclosed as such). Same job, same read-only permissions (contents: read) - no write-back. Does NOT close a later regression of an already-baselined AC that never touches the baseline file; disclosed as an open follow-up.
